|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata versions are [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]] (PC-E1) and [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). The image here is the Virtual Block 7.3 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Kessel_Surveillance_System.png]], marked E), which shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-kesselsurveillancesystem-pre.gif]]) and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-10-front-master.png]]) print the PC-E2 text (see [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]]); the PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011): “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may ▼ Spice Mine Administrator here.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip carries the errata mark E.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) changed “if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck” to “if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck”, removed “make that Force”, and printed “Opponents”, “Oncer” and “owners”: “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponents Force drains are -1 here. Oncer per turn, if you just lost a card from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owners Lost Pile to satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game, may deploy Spice Mine Administrator here.”<ref name="cl-1273_10-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list writes the slip's ▼ as “deploy”; that alone is not a version.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) has the release-sheet text with “Moruth Doole” for “Spice Mine Administrator” (and no comma after “Once per game”): “Deploy on a Kessel site. Opponent's Force drains are -1 here. Once per turn, if you are about to lose Force from Reserve Deck, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to make that Force satisfy 1 additional Force loss. Once per game may ▼ Moruth Doole here.”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image (marked E) prints the same text.
|hatnote=For the later errata texts, see [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata)]] and [[Kessel Surveillance System (Errata 2)]].
